capabilities: Create expiring blocks from the command palette or editor right-click menu
Clear block contents automatically when the chosen lifetime expires
Renew blocks by editing them or via a renew button
Set the default lifetime in days in settings
Store blocks as plain Markdown toggle lists with an invisible comment
extras: The marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that expired contents are deleted from the note, and that the plugin scans Markdown notes on startup and every two hours while Obsidian is open.
problem: Daily notes and temporary headings accumulate stale scratch content like links and half-thoughts that users must remember to delete manually.

relations.evidence: Install Editor Enhancer as well and expiring blocks also get Notion-style drag handles

summary: Self-clearing scratch blocks inside notes that expire after a chosen number of days unless edited, stored as plain Markdown toggle lists.
